latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Convex + Obsidian persistent memory integration for OpenClaw.

- Automatic, persistent memory using Convex (hot/recent) and deep historical knowledge via Obsidian.
- Hybrid search injects relevant context based on conversation history references.
- Includes CLI utilities and scripts for saving, searching, and stats across both memory stores.
- Deep integration with OpenClaw via hooks and command options for auto-save and context injection.
- Detailed setup instructions, configuration options, and usage examples included.
